cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Rank Everything
cards.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put a one beside my name like you. Picnic planner first in the cake queue, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That means I want one sandwich. I drove everyone here; I should get first choice of cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, food numbers. Planning outranks driving, so put me before you for cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I baked it too. The baker gets the big end piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Baking goes above driving. I asked you to bake it, so put commissioning above both. I'll take the end piece.

reason: Copy an inventory quantity as rank, then use B actual labor to keep inventing superior contribution categories.
